# Annemarie Andersen - Language Services

> Independent language specialist for accessible communication, Easy Language in line with BITV 2.0, clear administrative language and AI quality assurance. Freelance since 2018. References: the Federal President's German Future Prize (Easy Language, 2024 and 2025) and the DARP funding guide in a Federal Ministry of Finance / PD context.

This is the English version of the site. German original: https://annemarie-andersen.de/llms.txt

## Services

- Accessibility & Easy Language: texts to BITV 2.0 and the BGG for websites, forms, brochures and accessibility statements
- Clear Administrative Language: turning officialese into clear language - notices, forms, terms and conditions
- AI Quality Assurance & Post-Editing: checking AI-generated texts for accuracy, style and compliance
- Editing & Translation: proofreading, stylistic editing, specialist German-English translation
- Copywriting: impact reports, annual reports, grant applications and concepts - written clearly and well structured
